description: Controls bar of `v-video`, also usable on its own.

props.actions: Which built-in and custom actions to render, in order. Accepts an array or a space/comma separated string. Built-ins: `play`, `progress` (when omitted, the progress bar is placed above the controls), `time`, `elapsed`, `remaining`, `volume`, `fullscreen`, and `-` (a spacer). With **pills**, actions wrapped in parentheses (or a nested array) share one box, and `-` splits it. Any other name renders the `action.<name>` slot, which can also replace a built-in. `prepend` and `append` slots render at the edges unless listed.
props.buffer: End of the buffered range shown on the progress bar, in seconds.
props.chapters: Splits the progress bar into chapters. Each item needs a `start`, given as seconds or formatted time (`'1:30'`), and can have a `title`.
props.color: General color applied to icons and sliders.
props.detached: Moves the container below so it won't obstruct the video.
props.duration: Duration of the video, in seconds.
props.floating: Introduces visual spacing from the video boundaries.
props.fullscreen: Shows the exit icon on the fullscreen button.
props.gap: Space between actions. Pass `[controls, pills]` to set the gap between **pills** and the gap inside them separately.
props.hideProgressBar: Hides the progress bar, including the stacked one.
props.muted: Locks the volume control in the muted state.
props.pills: Makes the container transparent and shows inner actions in separated boxes.
props.playing: Playing state. Switches the play button to the pause icon.
props.playProps: Props passed to the default play button, e.g. `color`, `variant` or `size`.
props.progress: Current playback time, as a percentage of the duration (0 ~ 100).
props.progressColor: Color of the played part of the progress bar.
props.progressVariant: `pill` gives the progress bar the MD3 look with a bar-shaped thumb. `wavy` also draws the played part as a wave.
props.rounded: Rounds the container, or each pill when **pills** is set.
props.seekStep: Seconds moved by the arrow keys on the progress bar. Shift multiplies it by 10, or pass `[step, shiftStep]` to set both.
props.volumeProps: Props passed to the VMediaVolume component, e.g. `inline` or `direction`.
props.volumeSlider: `visible` shows the volume slider, `hover` keeps it collapsed until the control is hovered or focused, `hidden` leaves only the mute button.

events.update:playing: Emitted when the playing state changes.
events.update:progress: Emitted when the playback progress changes.
events.update:volume: Emitted when the volume value changes.
events.click:fullscreen: Emitted when the fullscreen button is clicked.

exposed.toggleMuted: Switches between 0 and the last non-zero volume. Does nothing while **muted**.

slots.progress: Replaces the progress bar, also when it is stacked. Receives `props` to bind on `v-media-progress-bar`.
slots.time: Replaces the text of the `time` action. Receives the player state, formatted times are in `currentTime`.
slots.time.elapsed: Replaces the elapsed time wherever it is shown.
slots.time.remaining: Replaces the remaining time, including its minus sign, wherever it is shown.
slots.time.total: Replaces the total duration wherever it is shown.
slots.play: Replaces the play button. Receives `props` to bind on your own button.
slots.[`action.${string}`]: Renders the action of the same name listed in **actions**. Receives the player state and methods.
slots.default: Replaces all controls. Receives the player state and methods.
